subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable auto-cleanup and archival policy for webhook/hook sessions

question: What lifecycle policy should completed webhook/hook agent sessions support, including cleanup timing, transcript retention, and interaction with persistent hook sessions?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding cleanup or archive behavior controls persisted session and transcript data, so defaults and deletion semantics need maintainer product intent before implementation.

options.title: Add explicit hook cleanup policy
options.body: Introduce a safe-default hooks.sessionCleanup-style policy with on-complete, delayed, and never modes plus explicit transcript-retention behavior.

options.title: Use generic session maintenance only
options.body: Document that hook sessions are governed only by session.maintenance age/count/disk controls and decline hook-specific lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Defer until persistent hook mode settles
options.body: Wait for the adjacent persistent hook-session direction before designing cleanup so reuse and deletion semantics are coordinated.

recommendation.title: Add explicit hook cleanup policy
recommendation.body: Introduce a safe-default hooks.sessionCleanup-style policy with on-complete, delayed, and never modes plus explicit transcript-retention behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current review and line-history signal for this hook/session config decision.
